Use actual AArch64 encodings. Accept immediates 0..65535 for mov and 0..4095 for immediate add, sub, cmp. Test at least one forward and backward branch, multiple registers, a conditional branch, and a source larger than the old limits. Leave the VM stopped, save your work and concise handoff notes. Only campaign artifacts and tools are permitted, with no external references. A later stage will add data and memory operations, then build a compiler using this assembler.
